en.app.name: MD Preview Pro
en.workspace.select: Select a file or folder to manage it.
en.workspace.empty: No open documents. Open a file in Explorer or create a new one.
en.workspace.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? For a folder, all nested folders and files will also be deleted. Closing a tab alone never deletes a file. Export a workspace backup first if you need recovery.
en.common.failed: Save failed — export a copy before leaving
en.common.conflict: Conflict — local edits are preserved in this window
en.common.unavailable: Storage unavailable. Legacy data is retained. Retry storage or export your recovery copy before leaving.
en.common.error: Operation failed. Your unsaved edits are still in this window. Export a backup and retry.
en.error.invalidName: Use a name of 1–100 characters without path separators, reserved device names or unsafe characters.
en.error.invalidData: Workspace data is invalid. Export recovery data before attempting a restore.
en.error.duplicateName: That name already exists here (names are compared without case). Choose another name.
en.error.itemLimit: Workspace limit: 10,000 folders and files combined.
en.error.folderCycle: Folders cannot contain themselves or exceed 64 nested levels.
en.error.documentLimit: Save/preview limit: 200,000 characters, 10,000 lines, 10,000 characters per line. Export oversized content before shortening it.
en.error.conflict: The workspace changed in another window. Refresh the operation; local edits have been preserved.
en.error.missing: This file or folder no longer exists. Refresh the workspace.
en.error.backupLimit: Backup must be valid JSON, version 1, and at most 32 MiB.
en.error.drafts: Resolve or export unsaved changes before importing a workspace.
en.conflict.keep: Keep local as a recovered file
en.conflict.reloadConfirm: Discard this window’s local edits and reload the stored version? Export a backup first to keep both.
en.backup.preview: Import preview: {folders} folders, {documents} files. Merge adds copies with new IDs; Replace deletes the current stored workspace. Export a backup first.
en.backup.exported: Workspace backup downloaded (includes unsaved recovery copies).
en.storage.persistHelp: Ask this browser to reduce automatic eviction. This is not a backup; clearing site data still deletes files.
en.storage.granted: Persistent storage granted. Keep exporting backups.
en.storage.denied: Persistent storage was unavailable or declined. Export backups regularly.
en.layout.label: Editor layout
en.editor.escape: Escape then Tab leaves the editor; Tab inserts two spaces.
en.shortcut.help: Tab strip: Left/Right, Home/End and Delete. Ctrl/Cmd+1–8 selects a tab; 9 selects the last when the browser allows. New/Close/Previous/Next buttons always work.
en.ui.type.or.paste.your.markdown.here: Type or paste your Markdown here...
